skill_name: What are the different ways of treating depression?
workflow: The different ways of treating depression include medication, psychotherapy, lifestyle changes, functional improvement techniques, complementary therapy, self-care, and support groups. Medication includes antidepressant medications, antipsychotics, and other medications such as mood stabilizers. Psychotherapy involves talking with a qualified mental health professional and can include cognitive-behavioral therapy, interpersonal therapy, and other forms of psychotherapy.
